title: Saw sharper UAP video on the inside than released footage

tellings.quote: I've definitely been exposed to a mix of quality both in terms of the visual fidelity and in the resolution of what this object is.

plain: Inside the Pentagon, around 2018, there were videos of UAP (the government's term for UFOs) that were sharper and clearer than anything released to the public, says Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower. He tells Michels he saw them himself and was shown "a mix of quality", both in how clear the picture was and in how well it showed what the object was. If true, the government holds better evidence than the public has seen.
